tools.name: zambia_job_alerts.discovery_resources
tools.description: Return public discovery endpoints for agents, including llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap, API catalog, auth policy, and agent skills.

tools.name: zambia_job_alerts.open_current_page_markdown
tools.description: Return the current page URL and instructions for requesting the Markdown representation with Accept: text/markdown.

tools.name: zambia_job_alerts.search_jobs
tools.description: Build a public Zambia Job Alerts job search URL for a keyword and optional location. This is a read-only navigation helper.

keywords.description: Job title, company, skill, or sector to search for.

location.description: Optional Zambia location such as Lusaka, Ndola, Choma, Kitwe, or remote.
